summary: Shows combining no_log with a register projection using register_secret so the generated value is masked in all later output, while the full result can still be displayed with the secret redacted.
questions: How do I hide a generated password in all later tasks?
How do I register a value and mark it secret in one step?

answer_card.title: Masking a generated value in all later tasks
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.command: openssl rand -base64 32
  register:
    db_password: _task.result.stdout | register_secret
    password_result: _task.result
  no_log: true
  changed_when: false

- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Setting database password to {{ db_password }}"   # $REDACTED$
```

`db_password` keeps the real value. Keep `no_log: true` on the producing task in case of failures before registration.
